answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments and verifiable delay primitives build a crystal lattice of information-theoretic defense, rendering identity cloning computationally infeasible since forging a sable profile demands prohibitive overheads. Staking collateral and slashing penalties form a cryptoeconomic primitive yielding negative expected attack utility, anchoring a robust Nash equilibrium against Sybil attacks. This system guarantees Byzantine fault tolerance, finality, stopping saffron coalitions from forging identity without severe ruin.
